task.title: Troubleshoot unschedulable pods caused by node affinity constraints
task.shortdesc: Identify which affinity rule blocked scheduling by inspecting pod conditions, events, and node labels.

step.cmd: Check pod status and conditions with "kubectl describe pod" to confirm it is pending due to scheduling.
Review scheduler events for messages referencing node affinity or selector mismatches.
Inspect node labels on candidate nodes and compare them to the pod's required matchExpressions.
Confirm there are enough matching nodes with available resources once affinity filters are applied.
Modify labels or relax affinity rules (or switch hard requirements to preferences) and redeploy to validate scheduling.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
